item.title: Nichiyoubi no Yaoya
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: shiisanmei
  • 発売日: 2012-02-05
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 日曜日の八百屋
  • 英語名: Nichiyoubi no Yaoya

あらすじ

Yes, this is the place where a selfish god throws a tantrum and makes things difficult for me…

Onoshiro Town-

There is a town somewhere in Tokyo where spirits live, but there are no shrines or temples.

A poor girl who is a repeat student but still wears a high school uniform arrives there, along with a young local man who has nothing but girls on his mind, and a carefree god who protects the rundown apartment building.
